entries.text: You see Jeremiah, a messenger for the Children.
entries.source_text: You see Jeremiah, a messenger for the Children.

entries.text: You see a Child. He looks pensive.
entries.source_text: You see a Child. He looks pensive.

entries.text: Excuse me, brother. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?
entries.source_text: Excuse me, brother. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?

entries.text: Quip!
entries.source_text: Quip!

entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.source_text: What are you doing?

entries.text: Ah, yes, a super mutant in training. I will return to my tasks.
entries.source_text: Ah, yes, a super mutant in training. I will return to my tasks.

entries.text: If you do not know, it is none of your concern. If you are inquiring about something you should not know, then I will have to report you to our supervisors. You should know better.
entries.source_text:
If you do not know, it is none of your concern. If you are inquiring

entries.text: I am a person of high importance.
entries.source_text: I am a person of high importance.

entries.text: I'm sorry to have bothered you.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry to have bothered you.

entries.text: I am new here.
entries.source_text: I am new here.

entries.text: Who the hell are you to be asking me questions?! You're lucky I don't report you to the holy flame!!
entries.source_text:
Who the hell are you to be asking me questions?! You're lucky I don't
 report you to the holy flame!!

entries.text: Transferring the reports, of course.
entries.source_text: Transferring the reports, of course.

entries.text: Reports of what? If I may ask.
entries.source_text: Reports of what? If I may ask.

entries.text: And a mighty fine job you're doing.
entries.source_text: And a mighty fine job you're doing.

entries.text: That is all. Thank you.
entries.source_text: That is all. Thank you.

entries.text: Very well, then. Peace be with you.
entries.source_text: Very well, then. Peace be with you.

entries.text: I apologize. How may I be of service?
entries.source_text: I apologize. How may I be of service?

entries.text: What is it you are doing?
entries.source_text: What is it you are doing?

entries.text: You can start by answering my question.
entries.source_text: You can start by answering my question.

entries.text: You can die!
entries.source_text: You can die!

entries.text: Guards!!!
entries.source_text: Guards!!!

entries.text: It is obvious you do not belong here. Who are you?
entries.source_text: It is obvious you do not belong here. Who are you?

entries.text: I am actually a Vault Dweller and would like to speak to the Master.
entries.source_text: I am actually a Vault Dweller and would like to speak to the Master.

entries.text: Um... Dorpheus... hmm... Morpheus sent me.
entries.source_text: Um... Dorpheus... hmm... Morpheus sent me.

entries.text: I am Loki. An initiate from the south.
entries.source_text: I am Loki. An initiate from the south.

entries.text: No, I don't belong here. But I know where this bullet belongs... in your head.
entries.source_text:
No, I don't belong here. But I know where this bullet belongs... in
 your head.

entries.text: I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas. But you should know this. [looking suspicious] Who are you?
entries.source_text:
I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas. But
 you should know this. [looking suspicious] Who are you?

entries.text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.
entries.source_text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.

entries.text: It is none of your business who I am... just answer my questions!
entries.source_text: It is none of your business who I am... just answer my questions!

entries.text: You are not to know who I am, it is the wish of the Master.
entries.source_text: You are not to know who I am, it is the wish of the Master.

entries.text: You dare question who I am? Fool, I should strike you down where you stand.
entries.source_text:
You dare question who I am? Fool, I should strike you down where you
 stand.

entries.text: That's rather odd... I've never heard of you.
entries.source_text: That's rather odd... I've never heard of you.

entries.text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.
entries.source_text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.

entries.text: I am of the High Order. Only the Master and Morpheus know of me in order to ensure my safety on the outside. But I have been called back by order of the Master.
entries.source_text:
I am of the High Order. Only the Master and Morpheus know of me in
 order to ensure my safety on the outside. But I have been called back by
 order of the Master.

entries.text: Please forgive me. I apologize for questioning you. Please carry on about your business, and if I can be of any service let me know.
entries.source_text:
Please forgive me. I apologize for questioning you. Please carry on
 about your business, and if I can be of any service let me know.

entries.text: I do not know who you are, and you do not belong here. Guards!!!
entries.source_text: I do not know who you are, and you do not belong here. Guards!!!

entries.text: Who are you and what are you doing down here?
entries.source_text: Who are you and what are you doing down here?

entries.text: I am a worshiper and I am lost.
entries.source_text: I am a worshiper and I am lost.

entries.text: Morpheus sent me with a message for the Master.
entries.source_text: Morpheus sent me with a message for the Master.

entries.text: Looking for a lonely soul to send to heaven.
entries.source_text: Looking for a lonely soul to send to heaven.

entries.text: Urk!
entries.source_text: Urk!

entries.text: You are not allowed in this area. Only Servitors and higher allowed down here. Return to the Cathedral proper.
entries.source_text:
You are not allowed in this area. Only Servitors and higher allowed
 down here. Return to the Cathedral proper.

entries.text: I apologize for any trouble I have caused.
entries.source_text: I apologize for any trouble I have caused.

entries.text: May I ask you some questions before I leave?
entries.source_text: May I ask you some questions before I leave?

entries.text: OK, but not before I split your head open.
entries.source_text: OK, but not before I split your head open.

entries.text: Morpheus would not send a slag like you on such a mission. Guards!!
entries.source_text: Morpheus would not send a slag like you on such a mission. Guards!!

entries.text: You idiot! You are not allowed in this area. Return to the Cathedral proper at once!
entries.source_text:
You idiot! You are not allowed in this area. Return to the Cathedral
 proper at once!

entries.text: Akay.
entries.source_text: Akay.

entries.text: Hunh.
entries.source_text: Hunh.

entries.text: Nah.
entries.source_text: Nah.

entries.text: I transfer records for the Master. That is all you need to know, my child. Now, you must leave.
entries.source_text:
I transfer records for the Master. That is all you need to know, my
 child. Now, you must leave.

entries.text: I will leave now.
entries.source_text: I will leave now.

entries.text: I just wish to ask you a few more questions.
entries.source_text: I just wish to ask you a few more questions.

entries.text: I'll leave. I'll leave. But not until I blow your brains out.
entries.source_text: I'll leave. I'll leave. But not until I blow your brains out.

entries.text: How did you get in here?! What are you doing sneaking around?
entries.source_text: How did you get in here?! What are you doing sneaking around?

entries.text: I just wish to ask you a few questions.
entries.source_text: I just wish to ask you a few questions.

entries.text: No, you may not ask me any questions. Now leave.
entries.source_text: No, you may not ask me any questions. Now leave.

entries.text: Stop! You have no business being here!
entries.source_text: Stop! You have no business being here!

entries.text: Duh?
entries.source_text: Duh?

entries.text: Sorry. I'm lost. I'll leave now.
entries.source_text: Sorry. I'm lost. I'll leave now.

entries.text: But I do have business here. Morpheus sent me on a mission for the Master.
entries.source_text:
But I do have business here. Morpheus sent me on a mission for the
 Master.

entries.text: I followed a suspicious looking character down here. Have you seen him?
entries.source_text:
I followed a suspicious looking character down here. Have you seen
 him?

entries.text: No. Killing is my business and business is good.
entries.source_text: No. Killing is my business and business is good.

entries.text: No, I have not seen anyone. What did he look like?
entries.source_text: No, I have not seen anyone. What did he look like?

entries.text: Doesn't matter. I think he got away.
entries.source_text: Doesn't matter. I think he got away.

entries.text: It was a short little green man.
entries.source_text: It was a short little green man.

entries.text: He was about your height but was wearing a leather jacket... What do you have on under those robes?
entries.source_text:
He was about your height but was wearing a leather jacket... What
 do you have on under those robes?

entries.text: He looked just like you, shit-for-brains!
entries.source_text: He looked just like you, shit-for-brains!

entries.text: Um... I... I... You don't actually think it's m... me?  How ridiculous. I've never!
entries.source_text:
Um... I... I... You don't actually think it's m... me?  How ridiculous.
 I've never!

entries.text: Ok. I'll be leaving then, but let me know if you see anything...
entries.source_text: Ok. I'll be leaving then, but let me know if you see anything...

entries.text: Yes! I do think it was you! Get down on the ground and spread 'em!
entries.source_text: Yes! I do think it was you! Get down on the ground and spread 'em!

entries.text: No, I don't believe it was you but may I ask you some questions?
entries.source_text: No, I don't believe it was you but may I ask you some questions?

entries.text: Yes, my brother. How may I be of service?
entries.source_text: Yes, my brother. How may I be of service?

entries.text: Yes, my sister. How may I be of service?
entries.source_text: Yes, my sister. How may I be of service?

entries.text: What is it that you do here, brother?
entries.source_text: What is it that you do here, brother?

entries.text: Just serve the Master. That's all I ask. Brother.
entries.source_text: Just serve the Master. That's all I ask. Brother.

entries.text: Sorry, wrong guy. All you guys look the same in these robes.
entries.source_text: Sorry, wrong guy. All you guys look the same in these robes.

entries.text: You can serve me by dying, you whacked out bastard!
entries.source_text: You can serve me by dying, you whacked out bastard!

entries.text: I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas.
entries.source_text: I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas.

entries.text: That is all. Thank you.
entries.source_text: That is all. Thank you.

entries.text: I would like to ask you a few more questions, brother.
entries.source_text: I would like to ask you a few more questions, brother.

entries.text: Yes, and a very important job it is. And do you understand the importance of your duties to the Master and all of us?
entries.source_text:
Yes, and a very important job it is. And do you understand the
 importance of your duties to the Master and all of us?

entries.text: Why, yes. I am the one who brings the Master the news of new, untainted humans untouched by radiation. I was the one who brought the Master the final news of a possible Lost Vault. It may still have pure-straing humans in it.
